title: OTel isn’t going well
summary: A critical analysis of OpenTelemetry (OTel) implementation challenges, where the author documents specific problems with a detailed spreadsheet. The article explores real-world pain points organizations face when adopting OTel for distributed systems observability.
problem_solved: Documents and addresses implementation friction, configuration complexity, and operational challenges with OpenTelemetry adoption in production environments.
why_valuable: Provides honest, data-driven insights into OTel's practical limitations, helping teams set realistic expectations and avoid common pitfalls during observability migrations.
